mapper.insert: insert into answer_record (user_id, paper_id, question_id, competition_id, stage_id, batch_id, user_answer, objective_score, subjective_score, is_correct, score_status, answered_at, scored_at) values (#{userId}, #{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{competitionId}, #{stageId}, #{batchId}, #{userAnswer}, #{objectiveScore}, #{subjectiveScore}, #{isCorrect}, #{scoreStatus}, #{answeredAt}, #{scoredAt})
mapper.update: update answer_record set subjective_score = #{subjectiveScore}, score_status = 'SCORED', scored_by = #{scoredBy}, scored_at = now() where user_id = #{userId} and question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: select * from answer_record where user_id = #{userId} and paper_id = #{paperId}
select * from answer_record where user_id = #{userId} and competition_id = #{competitionId} and stage_id = #{stageId}

select pb.batch_id, pb.batch_name, pb.mode, pb.paper_id, pb.start_time, pb.end_time, p.paper_name from practice_participant pp join practice_batch pb on pp.batch_id = pb.batch_id left join paper p on pb.paper_id = p.paper_id where pp.user_id = #{userId}
